source.note: "Retrieve a project": the response attributes list `default_branch` ("Default branch of the project") and `ci_config_path` ("Path to the CI/CD configuration file"); the page's own example is not reproduced, this is its shape trimmed to the fields the adapter parses, with an empty `ci_config_path` — the entity's documented example value is `''`. WP-139 reads it as GitLab's default `.gitlab-ci.yml`.

The project response shape of https://docs.gitlab.com/api/projects/ ("Retrieve a project") with a custom `ci_config_path`, which this page documents as a path relative to the repository root (its example `my/path/.gitlab-ci.yml`). The value is GoParking's (`deploy/.gitlab-ci.yml`) and the default branch `dev` is its too, as the product owner reported them; not recorded against an instance.

The project response shape of https://docs.gitlab.com/api/projects/ with a `ci_config_path` naming a file in another project, the page's documented form `.gitlab-ci.yml@namespace/another-project`. WP-139 counts it as CI that is present without reading it.
